text:
Maya K: Quick check — RFC review on Thu 9:00am PT. Need to lock authors + reviewers and timebox each item to keep the call tight. Who can take which review?

Priya: I can present my RFC and review one other if needed. 10m author + 5m Q&A sounds good.

Maya K: Plan I'm proposing: 10m author + 5m Q&A + 2m wrap. Also want to reorder slightly so longer docs go first.

Sean P: I can review Priya and Jin. Happy if Jin goes first (longer).

Jin: Yep I prefer an earlier slot — my doc has an eval section.

Alex R: I can present but happy to swap slots with Jin. Also volunteer to review Priya if Sean takes Jin.

Olga: Heads up I'm OOO Thu morning, available after 1pm PT. Can be fallback reviewer or take notes.

Priya: 1-pager promise — will drop a short summary + key sections in the thread by EOD Wed. Link will be in the doc.

Maya K: Tiny agenda snippet (will paste into invite):
```
- 09:00 - Quick sync + roll call (2m)
- 09:02 - RFC: Jin (10m + 5m QA)
- 09:17 - RFC: Priya (10m + 5m QA)
- 09:34 - RFC: Alex (8m + 5m QA)
- 09:47 - AOB + action items (13m)
```

Sean P: Suggestion: add fallback reviewer per RFC in the agenda line, so we can re-route if someone drops.

Maya K: Good call. I'll assign fallback reviewers now based on avail: Sean -> Priya, Alex -> Maya, Olga -> notes/fallback (if afternoon works).

DevBot: calendar:invite created by Maya K — Thu 09:00 PT — attendees: Maya K, Sean P, Priya, Alex R, Jin, Olga — link: https://calendar.example/evt/2175004321

Alex R: I'll move my slot earlier if Jin needs it. Added `timebox=10m` to the agenda line in the invite.

Jin: Confirmed — I'll take the longer slot and will upload the eval appendix. Also please add the label `rfc-eval` on the doc.

Priya: Uploaded 1-pager: https://drive.example/rfcs/priya-routing-prep.pdf — short TL;DR + testing plan.

Maya K: Final preflight checklist for Wed EOD: 1) authors confirm, 2) reviewers assigned + fallback, 3) 1-pagers uploaded, 4) agenda posted in invite. I'll ping again Wed 3pm PT as a reminder.

DevBot: reminder scheduled for Wed 15:00 PT for thread 2175004321

Olga: Can be fallback for notes and quick comments. If someone needs to swap, ping me and I'll cover asynchronously.

Sean P: :thumbsup: all good from me.

Alex R: :raised_hands: good to go.

Maya K: Thanks — I'll lock the ordering and post the final agenda after Wed 3pm check-in.

(End of thread)
